mappedIdentity.name: Furg Citadel

features.role: Individually named native ground outline of the historic hilltop citadel

identityStatus: The mapped ridge enclosure controls overall width, bend order and position. Independent terrain gives the east-to-west rise. The public-domain village view controls the recognizable south curtain and western compound profile.

terrainContact.basis: Source elevation beside the documented lower east gate, at the midpoint of the mapped eastern curtain.

notes: The official visitor inventory identifies the low east gate, middle zone and highest western compound, with rounded earthen masonry towers and successive repairs. Proportions of individual towers and incomplete masonry are estimated against the mapped width and the cleared ground view.
